title.title: XFunding Hub: the full workflow
title.sub: From a funding request to a settled deal. Recorded from the running app with demo data. No real money moves.
login.signIn: A treasury maker at the borrowing bank signs in.
home.work: Home lists the work waiting for this person.
form.enter: The maker enters what the bank needs: amount, tenor, deadline and settlement date.
draft.saved: The draft is saved. It needs at least one financial PDF before it can be submitted.
draft.uploaded: The PDF is stored privately and listed on the request.
draft.submitted: It now goes to an approver. A maker cannot approve their own work.
publish.queue: The review is waiting on this approver's Home page.
publish.review: The approver checks the terms and documents, then records a decision.
publish.approved: Approved. The request is now open to verified lenders.
bid.marketplace: Verified lenders see open requests in the marketplace.
bid.request: Lenders can see who the borrower is and read its documents. The borrower cannot see who the lenders are.
bid.form: The maker enters a rate and chooses the bank's approved settlement account.
bid.second: A second lender bids the same way, at a lower rate.
bid.needsApproval: The offer also needs an independent approver at the lending bank.
bid.approverQueue: The lender's approver opens the offer from Home.
compare.queue: Offers have arrived, so Home tells the maker to compare them.
compare.blind: This is the blind comparison: rates and terms only, with no bank names.
compare.proposed: The maker proposes the lowest rate. An approver must confirm the choice.
select.queue: The selection now waits for the approver.
select.review: The approver reviews the choice. Lender names are still hidden.
fee.deal: A deal now exists. The lender stays anonymous until the platform fee is confirmed.
fee.requested: The demo payment is requested. It stays pending until the provider confirms it.
fee.lenderWaits: The selected lender waits. Its identity and account stay hidden for now.
fee.otherBlocked: The lender that was not selected cannot open the deal at all.
provider.title: The provider confirms the fee
provider.sub: In this demo, a server command stands in for the provider's signed callback.
unlock.verified: The fee is verified, so the deal unlocks.
unlock.details: Now the borrower sees the selected lender and both accounts. This access is recorded in the audit history.
settle.lenderSends: The lender sends the money through its own banking channel. The platform does not move funds.
settle.borrowerRecords: The borrower's maker records receipt in the same way.
settle.needsApproval: This confirmation also goes to an independent approver.
settle.lenderApprover: The lender's approver reviews the confirmation.
settle.borrowerApprover: The borrower's approver reviews the confirmation.
settle.done: Both banks have confirmed, so the deal is settled.
settle.timeline: The timeline shows every step, newest first.
audit.history: An auditor can see who did what and when. Private reasons and banking details are not shown.
end.title: Requested, bid, selected, unlocked, settled
end.line1: A second person approved every request, offer, selection and settlement confirmation.
end.line2: Lenders stayed anonymous to the borrower until the fee was verified.
end.line3: The platform records the settlement, but the banks move the money themselves.
voice.title: XFunding Hub: the full workflow. From a funding request to a settled deal. This was recorded from the running app with demo data. No real money moves.
voice.scene.borrowerApproverFirst: Now, a different person at the same bank: the borrower approver.
voice.scene.meanwhile: Meanwhile, this is what the selected lender sees.
voice.scene.notSelected: And this is the lender that was not selected.
voice.provider.start: The payment provider confirms the fee.
voice.provider.callback: In this demo, a server command stands in for the provider's signed callback.
voice.end: Requested, bid, selected, unlocked, settled. A second person approved every request, offer, selection and settlement confirmation. Lenders stayed anonymous to the borrower until the fee was verified. The platform records the settlement, but the banks move the money themselves.
